real.title: Escalation: code review not converging (TEAM-5353, round 3)
real.description:
**The one open finding**

R3-1 (P2), owned by api_dev: one replay test still expects the old delete behaviour. It's at `lambda/agentcore-hub-tickets/replay-decision-contract.test.mjs:516`:
```js
expect(Object.keys(h.state.s3Objects).filter((k) => k.includes("/gates/"))).toEqual([]);
```
- **Cause:** the TEAM-5387 fix correctly made decision records never-delete, but this assertion wasn't updated.
- **Result:** the main vitest suite has 3735 passing and 1 failing, so CI will be red.
- **Repro:** `npx vitest run lambda/agentcore-hub-tickets/replay-decision-contract.test.mjs -t 'a close whose read predates a reopen'`
- **Siblings:** the matching tests in both ticket backends were already updated; this is the only one left.
- **Fix:** change the assertion to prove the kept old record can't authorize the new cycle. Don't bring the delete back.

**What the human gate (TEAM-5389) decides**
- **R3-1:** one of three options:
  - `DECISION: fix-r3-1` authorizes one more api_dev fix;
  - `DECISION: accept` means the engineer fixes the assertion themselves or accepts it with a reason;
  - `DECISION: stopped` stops the run.

real.title: Escalation #1: ship-review not converging (TEAM-5353, round 3)
real.description:
**Round-2 problems at the new head**
- **Fixed: R2-02.** Cancel and stop now refuse to run when a run has no Jira credentials or no epic id. Stop returns an error before writing anything, and cancel marks its work as incomplete so it can be retried. A test script and 19 focused tests confirm this.
- **Partly fixed: R2-01.** The Jira ticket tool now refuses if a cancel shows up on its second status read. The fix opened one new problem and left one gap, both below.

**New findings** (both in `lambda/agentcore-hub-jira/index.mjs`, inside the PR's changes)

| ID | Sev | Problem |
|---|---|---|
| R3-02 | P1 | If a human cancels a gate just as the tool closes it Done, the tool now skips putting it back to cancelled. The gate stays Done, its decision counts as approved, and downstream work is released. A test script shows the round-2 head restoring the cancel and the new head leaving the gate Done. This breaks the round-1 F2 fix (TEAM-5396) and was introduced by TEAM-5408. |
| R3-01 | P2 | A cancel that lands between the tool's last status read and its move back to Ready is still overwritten, and the tool reports the move as verified. Jira can't make the move conditional on the ticket's current status, so another read can't close this gap. It needs a rule in the Jira workflow itself, or a step that detects the overwrite and restores the cancel. |

**Checks:** all passed (exit 0): the sibling-copy check, the orchestrator size check, `git diff --check`, `tsc`, 458 vitest tests and 195 Jira tool tests. None of the existing tests covers either new problem; both were reproduced with test scripts. There are no new bot review comments since round 2.

**How the limit was hit:** each failed round counts 1, and a round that breaks an earlier fix counts 2. Rounds 1 and 2 count 1 each and round 3 counts 2, for a total of 4 against a limit of 3.

**Decision needed on TEAM-5412.** Add a comment with exactly one of these lines, then mark the ticket Done:
- **`DECISION: continue`**: I file one fix ticket to api_dev covering R3-01 and R3-02 plus a new CI run, and the review continues for up to 3 more rounds.
- **`DECISION: merge-with-known-findings`**: the two findings are accepted as known issues and the Merge Approval gate opens for your final merge decision.
- **`DECISION: cancel`**: nothing merges.
